human_name: Chromosome 22 short-arm rDNA + flanking segmental duplications

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 chr22 p-arm — 0 to centromere boundary (~15.1 Mb). rDNA array core at 4,793,794-5,720,650 (~927 kb). Coordinates from Nurk 2022, doi:10.1126/science.abj6987.

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: HPRC v1.1 acrocentric pangenome — chr22 PHR total 2.81 Mb. Per Guarracino 2023.

architecture_note: GRCh38 chr22 p-arm is N-masked. chr22 is the smallest acrocentric overall (~15 Mb p-arm). PHR = 2.81 Mb. Note this entry is for the chr22 SHORT arm (acrocentric SDs); the chr22q11.2 microdeletion syndrome is a SEPARATE long-arm locus (covered by a different T1 entry if/when added). Robertsonian rob(13;22), rob(14;22), rob(15;22), rob(21;22) are all reported but less common than rob(13;14).

rDNA_array.note: Second-smallest rDNA array (after chr14) per Nurk 2022

sst1_array.note: Present but less characterised than chr13/14/21 SST1 cluster — chr22 was less central in Guarracino 2023's inter-acrocentric NAHR analysis

primary.note: Standard acrocentric strategy. chr22 p-arm has less inter-chromosomal SD overlap than chr13/14/21 — may be more tractable.

primary_sources.note: Nurk S et al., Science. T2T-CHM13 v2.0. rDNA array chr22 4793794-5720650 (927 kb).
Guarracino A et al., Nature. chr22 PHR = 2.81 Mb.

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups — does not cover chr22 p-arm (N-masked in hg38)
ClinGen Recurrent CNV list — Robertsonian rob(13;22), rob(14;22), rob(15;22), rob(21;22). NOTE: 22q11.2 microdel syndrome is a DIFFERENT (long-arm) locus.
